note: Rewritten from Sjöstedt's original text (Arkiv för Zoologi vol. 7, no. 27; the extracted text carries no year of publication), original in German. The first descriptive paragraph of the original is not assigned to a caste, and the material line reads "Erithrea: Assab, einige Sold. und eine Menge Arbeiter"; on the measurement of the head with mandibles 6.6 mm it is judged to be the soldier. The OCR contains garbled forms (Filhler, Mandiheln, Zäbnen etc.), restored from context; the closing sentence of the worker section, on the mesonotum and metanotum, is cut off at the edge of the scan window and is not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closest to H. ochraceus, but larger; the mandibles are yellow-red with dark teeth instead of black, and the teeth are distinctly larger; the antennae have 29 segments (26—27 in H. ochraceus); the posterior lobe of the pronotum is deeply heart-shaped, not completely smooth and without a notch.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow, almost circular, slightly flattened into a quadrilateral and slightly narrowed anteriorly; the mandibles are yellow-red with the tips and teeth dark, curved inwards, with long black apical points, the right apical point slightly longer; the left mandible has 3 teeth and the right 2, the outermost tooth on each side much larger than the others; the antennae have 29 segments, the basal segment the thickest, about as long as the following 3 segments together, segment 2 about as long as segments 3 and 4 together, segments 3 and 5 equal in size, segment 4 scarcely noticeably larger than the two adjacent segments, the segments becoming progressively shorter towards the tip, the last the smallest and oval; the eyes are distinct, the anterior margin straight; the anterior lobe of the pronotum is slightly concave in the middle and the posterior lobe deeply heart-shaped; the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum are also distinctly angularly incised, the sides straight and converging posteriorly; the legs are pale yellow and unicolorous; the body colour is rather pale. Measurements: body length about 11 mm, head with mandibles 6.6 mm, head width 3.3 mm, mandibles 2.5 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head rounded-square, the posterior margin arcuately straight, the sides rather straight, red-yellow, the frons pale yellow with yellow streaks; the eyes are distinct, the anterior margin truncate; the antennae are pale yellow with 29—31 segments; the pronotum is about half as wide as the head (9:17), saddle-shaped, brown along the midline and pale yellow elsewhere, the anterior lobe arcuate, the sides rather straight and converging posteriorly, the rear flattened and slightly angularly incised; the mesonotum is about as wide as the pronotum, pentagonal, the sides rather straight and meeting at slightly obtuse rounded angles, the posterior margin slightly concave; the metanotum is similar in shape and slightly larger; both the mesonotum and metanotum are pale yellow with two brown pits on the anterior part of each; the abdomen and legs are pale yellow tinged with brown, entirely smooth and shining, covered with very fine sparse hairs, those on the ventral surface of the legs and on the abdomen slightly longer. Measurements: body length 9 mm, head width 3 mm; smaller individuals body length 8 mm, head width 2 mm.
